training.note: The Brazil point estimate is the sum of the state nowcasts; its interval is calibrated from summed independent rolling-origin residuals. Reported coverage is evaluated prequentially.

lasso.note: Point metrics use independent outer rolling origins. Coverage is prequential: every evaluated interval uses only national residuals observed at earlier origins.
